purpose: one-update real-backward and checkpoint reliability canary

rollout_batch.note: The first 24 errors were caused by the cached-bootstrap renderer permission regression; later exclusions were predominantly missing or uncertain judge responses.

utilization.measurement_kind: interval observations plus process logs; no complete run-level average was preserved
utilization.inference_interval: GPUs 0-3 remained approximately 98-100% busy during generation and were idle during external judge/render waits
utilization.trainer_interval: GPUs 4, 5 and 7 remained approximately 100% busy after batch dispatch while GPU 6 was idle after rank 2 failed

failures.cause: cached bootstrap reset the public renderer root to mode 0700, then returned before re-exposing it to the painter account
failures.live_repair: renderer traversal was restored before collecting the valid batch

failures.cause: four trainer ranks shared one Triton cache and rank 2 failed reading layer_norm_gated_fwd_kernel.cubin
failures.effect: three trainer ranks continued computing but no optimizer update completed

failures.cause: Prime logged the fatal rank exception internally, so the wrapper exception recorder never saw it and no distributed-failure receipt was written
failures.effect: the supervisor did not terminate the remaining ranks promptly

cost.scope: this whole-node rental including cold startup, failed first rollout wave, repaired rollout collection and partial trainer execution

required_repairs: preserve and re-prove cached renderer access
give every inference worker and trainer rank a private compiler-cache namespace
watch torchrun rank logs and fail the entire launch on a fatal marker
next_decision.topology: retain TP4 inference plus four 80GB trainer ranks
next_decision.rejected_topology: 5 inference plus 3 trainer: TP5 cannot divide this model's 24 attention heads and 4 KV heads, and the reviewed trainer initializer requires four ranks
next_decision.canary_scope: repeat one bounded update only after offline tests and reviewed source are pushed; do not scale curriculum until a native checkpoint and public portable adapter both verify
